briefdescription.para: Test that Runner properly forwards the deduce (-d) and verbose (-v) flags to the Compiler when it needs to recompile an out-of-date module.

detaileddescription.para: This test verifies the fix for the bug where Runner was not forwarding these flags to the Compiler during automatic recompilation. See Runner.java:159-167.

briefdescription.para: Test that Runner can recompile an out-of-date module and forwards flags correctly.

detaileddescription.para: This simulates the scenario Gene reported: running xec -d on a source file that needs recompilation.

briefdescription.para: Integration tests for the fully built XDK distribution.

detaileddescription.para:
These tests verify that:
Compiler can compile XTC source code with proper module path resolution
Runner can execute compiled XTC modules
Builder APIs work correctly in a real execution environment
XTC module dependencies (ecstasy.xtc, etc.) resolve correctly from the built XDK
Launcher handles invalid arguments gracefully

IMPORTANT: This test runs in the xdk project, which means it executes AFTER:
javatools has been compiled (Compiler, Runner, etc.)
plugin has been built (Ecstasy Gradle plugin)
All lib_* projects have been compiled by the plugin to produce .xtc files
The XDK distribution has been assembled with all XTC libraries
This is the correct place for functional/integration tests that need the complete XDK environment with all XTC libraries built and available.
